name: Ulupalakua

land: Faces the afternoon sun, the hottest of the day. Grapes ripen fuller, but morning dew lingers longer.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: Hawaii's first AVA, on the western slopes of Mount Haleakala on Maui. It covers about ⟦area|70 acres|28 hectares⟧ with about ⟦area|16 acres|6.5 hectares⟧ of vines, making it the nation's smallest appellation. Grapes are processed at the nearby Maui Wines facility.
